blogs.t: Why Igatpuri Is Becoming Maharashtra's Wellness Destination
b: Igatpuri sits in the Sahyadri hills, about 120 km from Mumbai and a short drive from Nashik. Misty monsoons, waterfalls and quiet valleys make it a natural escape from city life.

The best time to visit is the monsoon, June to September, when the hills turn green and waterfalls come alive. October to February brings cool, clear weather for weekends and celebrations. Bhavali Dam, Camel Valley, Vihigaon Waterfall and the Kalsubai trek are all close by.
That calm is why more travellers now come for retreats and slow weekends. Touchwood Bliss and Harmony Retreat were built around exactly that idea: nature first, rest first.
For land buyers, the same qualities, clean air, open views and the Samruddhi Highway nearby, make Igatpuri an interesting place to own a plot with Touchwood Lifespaces.

blogs.t: What Is a Self-Love Retreat, and Who Is It For?
b: A self-love retreat is a few days away from routine, with simple guided practices such as breathwork, circles, silent walks and time to listen to yourself.
It is not about affirmations or pampering alone. It is about meeting yourself beyond the roles you play and the responsibilities you carry.
Love You Zindagi by Harmony Retreat is designed for small groups, with a gentle schedule and nourishing pure vegetarian food at Touchwood Bliss, Igatpuri.

blogs.t: A Simple Guide to Choosing a Plot in Igatpuri and Nashik
b: Start with the location: distance to the highway, essential services, nearby landmarks and future connectivity.
Check the paperwork: NA status, clear title, approved layout and transparent pricing.

Visit the site at different times of day. A good plot should feel right, not just look right on paper. Touchwood Lifespaces projects such as Hillsyde, Riversyde and Naturesyde each come with their own setting and distances, so compare them on site.
